source.title: Data from: Mechanisms and implications of a type IV functional response for short-term intake rate of dry matter in large mammalian herbivores

coverageFromPublishedRecord.location: Brazil (two experimental sites described in the article)
coverageFromPublishedRecord.population: Heifers grazing Cynodon sp. and Avena strigosa monocultures
coverageFromPublishedRecord.target: Short-term dry matter intake rate while grazing
coverageFromPublishedRecord.design: Two experiments with sward-height treatments and repeated blocks; approximately 45-minute grazing sessions
notMeasuredForApprovedCase: full engine trajectory inputs and outputs

decision: Do not import data or compute metrics: the record confirms CC0 metadata and a relevant short-term intake-rate study, but this environment could not retrieve the CSV bytes. Even if retrieved, it is a separate heifer cohort and a short-term intake-rate outcome, not daily DMI or validation of the approved CPER adult-steer case.
limits: The metadata and file listing were publicly accessible, but both the documented API download and Dryad file-stream route denied the file request in this session.
The source is not the 2019-2020 USDA/CPER cohort and must not be pooled with its adult-steer ADG or behavior records.
Short-term intake rate in g DM/min is not interchangeable with daily DMI in kg/day.
